description: kaartportaal.drenthe.nl: rail datasets is a collection of datasets listed in National Georegister of the Netherlands, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by kaartportaal.drenthe.nl. Coverage: the area served by kaartportaal.drenthe.nl. The listing groups 5 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about rail; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Omgevingsvisie 2018 - Treinstation; Omgevingsvisie 2018 - Spoorlijn HOV; Infra, hoofdwegen en spoorwegen (historie); Uitvoering regio specifiek pakket, spoorwegen (RSP) (OGV, 2010) (histo. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-ngr-nl.
